 def round_cents(amount):

 def round_cents(amount):
     """Round a decimal amount to cents, halves away from zero."""
-    return round(amount, 2)
+    # Multiply by 100 to shift cents, then round halves away from zero
+    # Python's built-in round uses round half to even, so implement manually

 def compare(a, b):

+    for a_part, b_part in zip(a_parts, b_parts):

+            return -1
+        elif a_part > b_part:
+            return 1
+    return 0

metrics: model requests, model tokens and wall time per run
recovery: Gabriel runs that used repair cycles or extra plan versions
paired differences gabriel - baseline per task (mean over repetitions)
bootstrap percentile intervals, resampling task families with replacement (and tasks as a secondary view)
note: Protocol 4b (G3 route, evaluation) on the hard tier with gpt-4.1-mini: baselines, the reference-plan Gabriel and the episodic-retrieval ablation seeded with the 18 episodes of run4a-train-mini-saturated (training families only). The stateful family was never run before this protocol. A first freeze of this protocol carried an empty seed because the seed builder read unit paths of a moved run; it was discarded before any result was read and the builder was corrected.
purpose: Matched G1 coding comparison: increase independently verified task success or reduce resources at equal success, under a fixed task distribution and matched constraints. Not a benchmark of general capability.
sample_size_statement: 9 tasks in 3 families; the minimum relevant effect is not predeclared from a pilot, so intervals are reported as descriptive uncertainty, not as a powered test
verification: fresh, system-independent: changed paths within allowed_paths; visible tests exit 0; oracle installed from the corpus text and exit 0; all executed in the containment backend on the final tree
